verdict: Paid leads are holding; organic visibility and lead follow-through need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns delivered 127 leads at a cost of $11.45 per lead — a solid baseline. The most recent 7 days show a modest softening: leads are down about 6% and cost per lead has edged up to roughly $12.15, which is real movement but not a sharp drop. More notable is a near-complete stop in Google Business Profile activity over August 9–10, after averaging around 8 actions per day in late July; we're monitoring this closely to determine whether it reflects a seasonal dip in local search intent or a visibility issue that needs correcting. Separately, 127 leads have entered your pipeline over the period but none have converted to scheduled appointments, pointing to a gap in the follow-up process rather than anything in the ads; closing that intake gap is the priority for the weeks ahead. You should expect a cleaner picture of appointment flow as that process is tightened and calendar availability is entered into the system.
